import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv', names=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width', 'species'])

# Map species to a numerical value for plotting
species_map = {'setosa': 1, 'versicolor': 2, 'virginica': 3}
data['species'] = data['species'].map(species_map)

# Create a pairplot with seaborn
sns.pairplot(data, hue='species', markers=['o', 's', '^'], palette='husl')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Iris Flower Species Classification Dataset')
plt.xlabel('Measurement')
plt.ylabel('Value')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
